Business API map

A narrative, not an endpoint catalog. Sources: ../upex-bunkai-tms at origin/staging (98ee1b4), its route-posture snapshot, this repo's synced api/openapi.json, and the sibling maps. Full contracts: the OpenAPI spec; types: api/schemas/ via bun run api:sync.

Overview

The API lets a QA team run its whole discipline: author a requirement, anchor a reusable ATC to it, chain ATCs into Tests and Test Plans, run them, and turn a failure into a tracked bug, all joined back to where it started. A human in the browser and a CI job or AI agent with a Personal Access Token reach the same operations as the same principal.

Since August the API also moves money and data out: admins upgrade the workspace to the Cloud plan through Stripe hosted Checkout, owners export or delete the workspace, and system callers (Stripe, Vercel Cron) hit dedicated endpoints with their own credentials.

Authorization has two layers that must both agree: a capability check at the route (atc:read, atc:write, run:execute, workspace:admin) and Row-Level Security on every row. Every workspace-data read now requires a capability; the earlier "authenticated only" read debt (BK-499) is gone from the posture snapshot.

Cookie flow

  1. Sign in at /login (or POST /api/v1/auth/signin headless); Supabase sets sb-<ref>-auth-token.
  2. middleware.ts refreshes the cookie on page navigation and redirects signed-out users on protected prefixes; it does not gate /api/v1.
  3. API calls resolve the cookie in resolveIdentity; RLS scopes every query.

PAT flow

  1. Obtain bk_pat_<prefix>.<secret> (shown once; only hash and prefix stored).
  2. Send Authorization: Bearer …; the server verifies, loads scopes and the bound workspace.
  3. A per-request user JWT is minted so RLS sees the same auth.uid() as a cookie session.
  4. workspace:admin scope only when issued explicitly by an admin or owner of that workspace.

Journey: author, anchor, run

The core value: no test without a requirement, one ATC reused everywhere, comparable results.

  1. Story and ACs (atc:write); ready-to-test refused without an active AC (45010).
  2. ATC create inside one RPC transaction with its AC set; foreign or empty set refused (45020).
  3. Test built from the workspace library; reorder by chain step id.
  4. Run start (run:execute) snapshots the chain; marks are last-write-wins until closed (45212); finish or abort.
  5. The sweep aborts runs idle 4 h; clients must handle a run closing under them.

Endpoints: POST /user-stories/{id}/acceptance-criteria, PATCH /user-stories/{id}, POST /atcs, PATCH /atcs/{id}, POST /tests, POST /runs, POST /runs/{id}/steps/{stepId}/mark, POST /runs/{id}/finish, POST /runs/{id}/abort. Data: flow-story-atc, flow-test-run, state-run. Features: feature-authoring, feature-execution.

Journey: bug from a failed step

The differentiator: a defect keeps its execution context.

  1. POST /bugs (atc:write) re-checks the step is still failed (422 run_step_not_failed).
  2. Status moves forward one step (POST /bugs/{id}/status; 45310/45311).
  3. Assignment to an active non-viewer (POST /bugs/{id}/assign; 45312/45313) notifies the assignee.
  4. Reads collapse "missing" and "not a member" into one 404.

Data: flow-bug-from-step, state-bug. Features: feature-defects.

Journey: get in and grant access

Security-relevant privilege grants.

  1. POST /workspaces (any authenticated caller, the one capability-free write) makes the caller owner.
  2. POST /workspaces/{id}/invites (workspace:admin) at viewer/member/admin; never owner.
  3. POST /invites/accept (authenticated; caller is not yet a member) never demotes; any invalid token is 404 "Invite token is invalid.".
  4. POST /tokens cookie-only: a PAT can never mint a PAT.

Data: flow-onboarding, flow-invite. Features: feature-identity-access.

Journey: upgrade to Cloud

Revenue: the only call chain where money changes hands.

  1. POST /workspaces/{id}/billing/checkout (workspace:admin, Idempotency-Key): inserts the session row first, then creates the Stripe session; a second open session is refused.
  2. The client follows the Stripe URL; payment happens off-platform.
  3. Stripe calls POST /billing/webhook: signature verified, event deduped; completed sets plan and seats; failed or expired releases the lock; other types 200 ignored.
  4. POST /workspaces/{id}/billing/checkout/cancel closes an open session.
  5. GET /workspaces/{id}/billing (atc:read) shows plan and meters.

Data: flow-billing-upgrade, state-checkout-session. Features: feature-account-billing.

Journey: export, delete, restore a workspace

High blast radius: data leaves, or everything becomes unreachable.

  1. POST /workspaces/{id}/data-export (cookie-only, owner): queues one export; GET polls status; GET …/download re-checks and streams, auditing each download.
  2. DELETE /workspaces/{id} (cookie-only, owner): soft delete, access ends for everyone, tombstone written.
  3. Every workspace-scoped endpoint must then answer as not found (BK-991 helper guard, BK-988 invite parity).
  4. POST /workspaces/{id}/restore (cookie-only, owner) within 30 days; purge after.

Data: flow-workspace-export, flow-workspace-deletion. Features: feature-account-billing.

Journey: import from Jira

Async, partial-failure tolerant, with a per-project lock.

  1. POST /imports (atc:write): 409 if one is active, else 202 and an after() worker.
  2. GET /imports/{id} (atc:read) polled every 2 s.
  3. Worker pages Jira with backoff, upserts by Jira key, records per-issue errors; ends completed or failed.

Data: flow-jira-import. Features: feature-authoring.

Architecture behind the API

Client to Vercel edge to withApiHandler to domain module to bunkai_* RPC to Supabase Postgres (RLS); side paths to Stripe, Resend, Jira, Storage and Realtime.

ComponentRoleTouchesWhy it matters for QA
withApiHandlerSingle gateway: posture, request id, logs, error envelopenone directlyA bug here is systemic; posture is compile-time mandatory
principal.ts + bearer.tsCookie or PAT into one principal; impersonation JWTSupabase Auth, token tablesCookie and PAT behaving differently on a required route is a real bug
lib/<domain>/errors.ts + RPCsBusiness invariants, SQLSTATE mappingPostgresWhere negative cases live
Billing routes + webhookCheckout and plan changeStripe, PostgresAsync, idempotent, money
admin/send-digestCron-triggered emailResend, PostgresThird principal class; secret-gated
after() workersJira import, data exportJira, Storage, service roleNo sweep for a killed worker
pg_cronRun sweep, workspace purgePostgresState changes with no API call
Supabase RealtimeRunner live updatesSupabaseDropped channel means stale UI, not a broken run

  • No admin remove-member or change-role endpoint.
  • Stripe key mode on staging not verified; webhook retries and ordering under Stripe's own delivery not observed.
